scope: User-requested repro on the disposable local podman stack: detection of a saved browser session ended by a full application import, and the resumable awaiting_reauth deployment outcome

target.runtime: worktree build of 2.0.0 source with this change (not published)

finding.observed: Post-deploy E2E with saved storageState reached the login page after a full import and ship reported POST_DEPLOY_TEST_FAILED although SQL passed 5/5

e2eProbe.note: Saved state (not expired by its metadata) was created before the earlier noop full import; the probe found the real APEX 26.2 login page instead of the apexrest-crm marker

shipApply.note: The session had already ended before this run; this run confirms classification and the stop state, not a new session loss

resumeAfterInteractiveLogin.probeNote: This app shows its marker on the Customers page, not on the base URL, so with valid state the probe returned unknown and the specs decided the result

interactiveTestAuth.followUpE2E: apexrest test e2e --env dev passed 1/1 with that state
